m.aarti.tek: Victory to you, son of Kaśyapa; Om, victory to you, son of Aditi, destroyer of the darkness of the three worlds, sandalwood to the hearts of devotees.
m.aarti.pad1: You shine on the chariot of seven horses, bearer of the single wheel; you take away sorrow and bring happiness, and remove the impurity of the mind.
m.aarti.pad2: Gods, sages and brahmins worship you; you are pure and rich in glory. You are Divākara, the maker of day, who crushes the hosts of sin, garlanded with divine rays.
m.aarti.pad3: You are Savitā, the source of all good deeds, who brings what is auspicious; the eye of the world, you are the one who releases from the heavy bonds of worldly existence.
m.aarti.pad4: You make the clusters of lotuses bloom and destroy the three afflictions. When you are served, you readily take away the fierce torment of desire.
m.aarti.pad5: Best of the gods, you cure diseases of the eye and relieve the distress of the earth; you always release the rain, and you are bound by a vow to the good of others.
m.aarti.pad6: Sūryadeva, source of compassion, have compassion now. Take away all ignorance and delusion, and give the knowledge of the truth.
